name: deepend
tagline: Heavy bass, sharp bars, strange covers, and whatever else survives shuffle.
bio: deepend is a longtime tilde and IRC dweller who spends an unreasonable amount of time running servers, writing code, breaking things, fixing them again, and generally living somewhere between a terminal and an IRC window.

Musically, genre boundaries are mostly treated as suggestions. Expect bass-heavy electronic music, trap, dubstep, hip-hop and freestyle, industrial and metal, remixes, mashups, covers, and the occasional song that makes absolutely no sense beside anything that came before it.
~/deepend runs twice a week with two recurring formats: ~/pull for discoveries and ~/dig for themed musical rabbit holes.
